steps.text: 7:16 P.M. \ Clear
Lungmen Central Park, Finball Stand

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Your finballs.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Oooh, such springy mouthfeel. Pretty good.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: This place definitely earned that recommendation in the Great Foodie Guide!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Glad you like it.

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: ...That finball guy kinda gives me the creeps.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: I know what you mean. Like, you're selling finballs, why do you have a big knife on the counter there?

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: The Foodie Guide says the owner is an old man called 'The Godly Finball Uncle.'

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: He couldn't be some kind of triad or something...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Hm? Did you want something else?

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Oh, no.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...customers have been so weird lately.
I'm sure it's got nothing to do with that 'Resting Triad Face' you've got going on.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: And this is what you wear to work? Think about how this makes Uncle Tung look.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Welcome back. Done with work?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You could say that. The office said you took some credit. How much?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: 32.60, rounded. You want to try one?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Where'd that come from? I don't have any change on me.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Consider it a token of my appreciation for doing so much to look after my business.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: All right. Don't mind if I do.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: It's tasty and all, but isn't this Uncle Tung's stall? A tribute made with borrowed goods is one without meaning.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You always have to get your digs in. This one's on me...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Okay then. You've definitely gotten better. I wish the other punks took things as seriously as you do.
Evening. I'll take some finballs.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Coming right up.
Take your time. I'm just enjoying the view of the river. Usually don't see it from this far away.
Smells nice. The Great Foodie Guide never gets it wrong.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...order up. Here's your change.
Thanks.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Please come again.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Waai Fu? What are you looking at?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: It's just that girl kinda weirded me out... do Sankta grow horns?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Must be some Sauin makeup or something.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: They looked real. Whatever. Idle gossip is an unbecoming habit.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What's next on the agenda? Back to the office?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Studying. I've got a test in two days.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You're spending Sauin studying?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Sauin is supposed to be about shepherding spirits into the afterlife. Our society has totally corrupted it with consumerism. Respectfully, I will abstain.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Not to mention, I don't get paid that much. I need to get my grades up and nab a scholarship.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Yeah, that sounds about right for you...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: It's their fault for being so out of touch. Don't lump me in with them.
Hm, I've still got some time. Where should I go next? Let's see, looks like there's some good eats around here...

steps.name: Curious Lungmenite
steps.text: Woah! What's happening up on the overpass? A car crash?

steps.name: Strolling Lungmenite
steps.text: Doesn't seem like a regular crash. Let's go check it out.

steps.name: Easygoing Lungmenite
steps.text: Another street fight? Count me in!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Friggin psychos, get away from meee!
Oh... so soon?
Looks like I'm on the clock already.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Ow... I was thrown clear...?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Thank heaven for guard rails. Otherwise we'd be a puddle down there.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Hurry up! Pull me out!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: They're trying to get away! Stay on them!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mmmff! This... airbag... it's smooshing me!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hold still! You're gonna crush my Lil Homie! Yo! Croissant! It's comin' outta your pay!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: It ain't me! I can't move at all with Texas on top of me!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Oof.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Then I guess it's up to me——!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Bison! Wait!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Everyone's crowding around. If they get away now we'll never catch them!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Pull me out already! That Forte kid's coming!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: I'm trying!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Don't move!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So... heavy...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Who——

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: A sniper?!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yo, Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: On it.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (They missed. Bad shot?)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (No, they're trying to hit the fuel tank——!)

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Huh, what's going on? Who's shooting at the Forte kid?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Focus! The wolf's on her way too! Pull me out already!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Wait, what's that smell? It's fuel! Hurry!!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Brother... it's what it is.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: You son of a——!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Damn! I can't——

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Ugh. Too late.
